periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique diagonal orientation at approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, tapering toward the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated teardrop morphology with a vertical axis approximately 1.5 times longer than the horizontal axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with the lowest vertex extending significantly below the geometric center of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shape curve along the posterior margin at the junction with the white dorsal fur.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Consistent thick band occupying approximately 35% of the visible upper torso vertical span.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Inter-pinna gap distance is roughly equivalent to the transverse width of a single pinna base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, continuous semicircular curvature across the superior boundaries.
